entries.title: On refusing to name things
entries.body: Some things become smaller when named too quickly. An image can stay open a little longer; it can hold a contradiction without resolving it.

entries.title: The Mechanical Curator
entries.body: A note on finding images in old books, and on the strange second life an image begins when it is detached from the page that once held it.

entries.title: A practice without titles
entries.body: The index gives each work an address. It does not tell the viewer what to see. That distinction leaves space for a meeting between the image and the person looking at it.
